items: Gears: spur and ring gears with real involute teeth (press O)
Place a gear beside another and it meshes, at the right center distance
In an assembly, a gear relation reads the ratio from the teeth and lines them up
Assemblies: join parts with mates, gears and screws
Animate a mate and save it as a video or GIF
Just press New → Assembly and insert parts from any of your documents
Type a circle's radius or diameter while drawing it
Work offline after your first visit
